answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 1355 Country: Pakistan Title: After urinating, is it compulsory to dry up the urinary part of the body with the help of a toilet paper, before washing it with water? Is it also compulsory to wipe the excretory hole with toilet paper before washing it with water? Question: After urinating, is it compulsory to dry up the urinary part of the body with the help of a toilet paper, before washing it with water? Is it also compulsory to wipe the excretory hole with toilet paper before washing it with water? Answer ID: 1355 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 786/786=J) (1) and (2) It is not necessary but better to do so: قال فی رد المحتار 1/550: ثم اعلم ان الجمع بین الماء والحجر أفضل ۔۔۔ الخ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
